role: The block dust puffed when an entity lands (RenderGlobal's blockdust name, with applyRenderColor).
scope_reason: In scope: an entity landing after a fall of more than three blocks makes the server send effect 2006 (EntityLivingBase.java:251); the client's RenderGlobal.playAuxSFX spawns up to 375 'blockdust_' particles from it, each spending two draws of the client world's Random first (RenderGlobal.java:2620-2621). The loop ran in 30 of 154 recordings; combat-mobs-s1 built an EntityBlockDustFX.

members.name: EntityBlockDustFX
members.note: EntityDiggingFX's constructor, then the motion set to the arguments; its own kind PLIVE_BLOCKDUST (the dump names the class), layer 1

notes: No behavior is ported. The scene renderer csrc/engine/raster_particles.c draws whatever class names the recorded state dump lists (base quads or icon quads), so a dump containing this class would render, but nothing constructs or ticks it natively. idxaudit 2026-09-27: was client_cosmetic/not_applicable; the scope reason did not hold (DEVLOG 2026-09-27, lane/idxaudit). Spawned only by playAuxSFX 2006 (a fall over 3 blocks, the server's S28), 140 in fx_client. lane/idxlast 2026-09-27: proven by the rendertick scene fx_client (seed 1, --particles 0, 143 ticks, 3,923 FX compared field by field against the oracle's dump, test_rendertick); it fails with the class changed (a negative control of 80 mismatches).
